title: DeFi Vision
tagline: DeFi Vision: AI-based wallet analyzer for risk-aware portfolio insights and recommendations
description:
Project Overview
DeFi Vision is a full-stack crypto portfolio analyzer and dashboard. It enables users to connect their Ethereum wallet and receive a comprehensive analysis of their DeFi holdings, token balances, and risk profile. The backend is built in Go (Gin), and the frontend uses React/TypeScript.

Powered by ASI
DeFi Vision leverages ASI (Autonomous Smart Intelligence) to deliver secure, AI-powered portfolio analysis. ASI provides advanced risk scoring and asset recommendations, ensuring users get actionable insights tailored to their unique wallet composition.

AI Agent Recommendations

The AI agent analyzes your wallet and market data to suggest which assets to buy, based on advanced price prediction models.
Recommendations are designed to reduce risk and optimize gains, focusing on portfolio health and diversification.
Unlike leveraged trading (going long or short), these suggestions do not expose you to liquidation risk—they are for portfolio improvement only.
Most agents only analyze individual assets; DeFi Vision analyzes your entire wallet for truly personalized suggestions.

Unique Selling Points (USPs)

Holistic Wallet Analysis:
Examines your entire wallet, including all tokens and DeFi positions, for a complete risk and opportunity profile.

AI-Powered Risk Analysis (ASI):
Uses advanced AI to assess risk, predict asset performance, and generate actionable recommendations.

Personalized Asset Recommendations:
Suggestions are based on your wallet’s unique structure and current market conditions, not just asset price predictions.

No Liquidation Risk:
Advice is for portfolio optimization, not margin or futures trading—no risk of forced liquidation.

Real-Time Data Aggregation:
Fetches live token balances and DeFi positions from sources like Zapper, always reflecting your current holdings.

Supports 50+ Blockchains:
True multi-chain portfolio analysis, covering all major networks and protocols.

Interactive, User-Friendly Dashboard:
Modern React/TypeScript frontend with interactive cards, charts, and badges for easy understanding and action.

Privacy and Security:
Secure wallet connection and analysis; your data is never shared or exposed unnecessarily.

Cloud-Ready and Extensible:
Modular backend, ready for cloud deployment and integration with other tools.

No Vendor Lock-In:
Open and extensible architecture for integration with other dashboards, dApps, or analytics platforms.

Features:
REST API for portfolio analysis
Fetches token balances and DeFi positions from Zapper
AI-powered risk analysis and recommendations
CORS enabled for local development
Multi-chain support (50+ blockchains)
how_its_made:
DeFi Vision is built as a full-stack application with a Go backend and a React/TypeScript frontend. The backend uses the Gin web framework for fast, modular API development and integrates with Zapper’s API to fetch real-time token balances and DeFi positions for any Ethereum wallet. All sensitive configuration, such as API keys and server settings, are managed via environment variables for security and flexibility.

For risk analysis and recommendations, the backend leverages ASI (Autonomous Smart Intelligence), an AI agent that processes wallet data and market information to generate risk scores and asset suggestions. This AI agent is designed to analyze the entire wallet, not just individual assets, which is a unique approach compared to most analytics tools.

The frontend is built with React and TypeScript, providing a modern, responsive dashboard. Users connect their wallet using MetaMask, and the frontend communicates with the backend via REST API calls. The UI is composed of reusable components for wallet connection, portfolio overview, token holdings, DeFi positions, risk analysis, and recommendations. Tailwind CSS is used for styling, ensuring a clean and consistent look.
